exposure: Immediate post-placental insertion of Cu T 380 A or Cu T 375 IUCD
cohort: The study included women who underwent Cu T insertion post-placental, either after vaginal delivery or intra-caesarean, at a hospital.
finding: The majority of patients (56%) reported an 80% satisfaction score with immediate post-placental IUCD insertion, and this score showed no statistically significant difference with obstetric score, gestational age, age, or socio-economic status.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in mean satisfaction score with the mode of delivery (vaginal vs. intra-caesarean).
